Filing gate: ① a measured red, filed by triage. The merge queue ejected two independent pull requests on one case, and the platform test list must not keep going red. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: the `domain:devx` lane seat. That lane landed PR #31230 (#30928), and the `examples/app-todo` suite is its own.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `loop-body-iteration`, `example-todo timeout` → only anchor #31294, which this card fixes.
class: a · type: Bug

## 维护者速读

示例应用 app-todo 有一个测试（循环升级流程，`loop-body-iteration.test.ts` 第一条用例）在合并队列里两次超过 vitest 默认的 5 秒上限，把两个与它无关的 PR 挤出队列。两次都发生在 PR #31230 合并之后：#31230 让这个示例包按源码解析三个平台包。疑似冷启动变慢，原因尚未实测。

## Measured

- Case: `examples/app-todo/test/loop-body-iteration.test.ts` › `#19206 — the loop body runs and binds currentTask` › `ESCALATION: the run reaches notify_owner …` (L134). It declares no timeout of its own, so the 5000 ms default applies. The cause line is `Test timed out in 5000ms`, not an assertion.
- Hit 1: queue build 42410962891 (PR #31249, `Test Core (8/8)`, 2026-11-07T20:25Z).
- Hit 2: queue build 42422774934 (PR #31258, 2026-11-07T22:54Z).
- Neither PR touches `examples/app-todo`. The test file has been unchanged since 2026-11-06 (`9d313f3ac7`).

## Not measured (hypothesis only)

- PR #31230 (`30f23fef48`, 2026-11-07T19:14Z) added package-wide source aliases to `examples/app-todo/vitest.config.ts`, for `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/plugin-auth` and `@objectstack/mcp`. Every test file in the package now transforms those packages from source instead of loading `dist/`. That would put the first case of each file, the one that pays `bootTodoKernel()`'s cold boot, near the 5 s line on a loaded shard. Both hits came after #31230 landed. Measure before acting on this.

## Ask

- Measure the case's real duration on `main`, cold and warm, with and without the #31230 aliases.
- Then fix it without losing what the case pins. Either set an explicit budget from the measurement (as PR #31284 did for #31281), or scope the source aliases to the file that needs them (`test/mcp-actions.test.ts`) if they are the cost. Then close anchor #31294.
- No test is skipped or quarantined.

Related: #31294 (anchor), PR #31230 / #30928, #31281 / PR #31284 (the same class, landed).
